note_en: Look at 证明它比人类司机更可靠 "prove it is more reliable than human drivers": the pattern is A 比 B + adjective. The adjective never changes form, so there's no "-er" or "more" built into it; 比 does the comparing, and 更 "even more" is optional. Note too that there's no "is": 它比人类司机更可靠, not 它是比....
